source.title: Oi!
source.description:
Oi! <class>! Yes, ye! Ye did me a solid by smashing up that depressin' mess of a meatsuit I've been riding in all these years, but I dinnae feel much of a pull to move on. I'm expectin' it's because I got some "Unfinished Business" to get up to 'afore I can be on me way. Well dull-wit, ye just been conscripted to help!

I need ye to fetch me 'ammer. Should be somewhere in Corrin's Crossing and it'll be hard to miss.

Oi, take this too. It's me favorite gold tooth. Give it a rub when you've found me weapon.
source.objective:
Find Orthas' missing hammer in Corrin's Crossing.

Provided item:
source.completion: Aye I'm much obliged tae ye! Now that we've got that out of the way, let's work on puttin the rest together so you can send me on me way!
